_readme: Four channels: all newly discovered matching jobs go to quiet internship/full-time feeds, including older postings labeled as such. Fresh or age-unverified watchlist jobs in ping_categories also go to important channels. Important jobs are queued individually without a count cutoff. First source baselines are silent. Unknown-age pings carry a warning; known old jobs never ping. Webhook values reference environment secrets. ops enables grouped coverage and recovery notices.
